title: Curfew
text:
DIRECTED BY JULIAN MEANS
CURFEW
CREATURE SIGHTINGS
IN COLDBROOK!
IS THIS
CREATURE
REAL?
Town folks have been
saying about this 'creature'
that is sneaking around
Coldbrook's surrounding
forest area. Multiple people
say they have seen it
running as fast as a
leopard, as tall as a
basketball hoop, and louder
than a school bell ringing.
The noises that it makes
during the night echo
throughout the town.
A Coldbrook citizen said,
"I can't sleep at night, the
only thing I can think about
is where that creature is,
and if it's going to attack
me!" No sightings have
officially been confirmed at
this time, but be aware if
these rumors are true,who
knows what's out there?
ATTENTION
PLEASE STAYOUT
OF THE

TOWN

9:00PM
until further notice
